objective: Activate P12 and implement a deterministic, regime-aware Knowledge Graph schema for market memory with explicit uncertainty, provenance and correlation-not-causation boundaries.
scope: Define governed node ontology for assets, markets, macro/news events, regimes, capital-flow states and rotation episodes
Define governed relationship ontology for observed associations and contextual links
Require validity period, regime context, sample count, signed strength, uncertainty and provenance on every edge
Generate deterministic node, edge and snapshot identities
Preserve source dataset versions and provenance SHA-256 lineage
Accommodate CIRA-001 capital-flow and rotation memory requirements
Forbid causality claims and direct trade authority in P12-A
out_of_scope: Signal probability, risk approval or execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: active task none, active lock none, open PR none
tests: CIRA node kinds CAPITAL_FLOW and ROTATION_EPISODE are present
Every edge requires validity period, regime, positive sample count, strength, uncertainty, provenance and dataset version lineage

Unknown node or relation kinds fail closed
Duplicate canonical nodes and duplicate edges fail closed

Node, edge and graph snapshot identities are deterministic and order-independent
No trade, probability, risk or execution authority fields are introduced
P12-A evidence is byte-identical across two runs
rollback: Revert P12-A ontology/policy/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P11 and CIRA-001 remain canonical.

Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
